title: AdaptRouter: Adaptive Routing across Evolving Tasks and Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.30162v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Model routing assigns each query to a suitable foundation model, but tasks and available models keep changing, and existing routers are either untrained for the pool at hand or fit once and forget earlier tasks when updated. We present AdaptRouter, an adaptive router trained by policy learning: a compact multimodal decision model reads each question with cards describing the current experts and learns from native task feedback, without routing labels, to select one frozen expert. Open-weight and API experts share the router, its inputs, and the quality-cost trade-off but use different losses: cheap open-weight experts are explored with RL, whereas paid API experts are queried once and their cached feedback is reused as soft labels. New tasks are learned without replay, new experts enter as cards, and an open-weight quality-first advantage provably keeps cost from overriding quality. Across four task stages, AdaptRouter loses at most 0.4

translated_title: AdaptRouter：面向不断演变的任务与模型的自适应路由器
translated_abstract: 模型路由旨在将每个查询分配给合适的基础模型，但任务和可用模型在不断变化，而现有路由器要么未针对当前模型池进行训练，要么只进行一次性拟合并在更新时遗忘早期任务。我们提出 AdaptRouter，一种通过策略学习训练的自适应路由器：一个紧凑的多模态决策模型结合描述当前专家模型的信息卡片来读取每个问题，从原生任务反馈中学习（无需路由标注），并选择一个冻结的专家模型。开源权重专家和 API 专家共享路由器、输入以及质量-成本权衡，但使用不同的损失函数：廉价的开源权重专家通过强化学习进行探索，而付费的 API 专家仅查询一次，其缓存的反馈被复用为软标签。新任务无需重放即可学习，新专家以卡片形式接入，并且开源权重专家的质量优先优势可以从理论上保证成本不会凌驾于质量之上。在四个任务阶段中，AdaptRouter 最多损失 0.4（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: AdaptRouter 是一种基于策略学习的自适应模型路由器，能够持续适应不断涌现的新任务与新专家模型，无需路由标注或旧任务重放，并从理论上保证质量优先于成本。
en_tdlr: AdaptRouter is a policy-learning-based adaptive model router that continuously adapts to evolving tasks and new experts without routing labels or replay, with a provable quality-first guarantee over cost.
